public_rationale: OpenRouter's request-log analysis supports rapid gains in Chinese-model usage during the period Marcus described. The gains extended beyond one customer category and beyond DeepSeek alone. This supports traction in the usage sense supplied by his context.
limitations: OpenRouter is one distribution platform, not a representative census of the entire AI market.
Token-intensive agents can increase token share without a matching increase in users or spending.
The retrospective report was published after the post but before the evaluation date.

our_interpretation: Traction means actual usage or adoption of models developed by Chinese labs.

Fast means substantial growth over weeks or months; Marcus supplies no numerical threshold.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show Chinese-model usage and adoption were broadly stagnant or declining during the described period.
